# Finite joining trees lift from specified fragments

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of its frame, with no premise, and then every finite joining tree lifts with its own leaves; with excluded middle as a hypothesis, a code reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts one with listed outcomes.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Read through a description, codes join where fragments with those codes join into one with that code. The description lifts the joining, every joining of the codes of two fragments coming from a joining of the fragments themselves, exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame; no premise. Where it lifts, a joining of codes is exactly the code of a joining of any fragments having them, and every finite binary tree of joinings lifts: the tree with its leaves read through the description joins into a code exactly where the tree with its own leaves joins into a fragment with that code; the leaves stay the given fragments. Where codes are passing the same branching tests, the description lifts the joining exactly where passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation of its frame; with excluded middle as a hypothesis, where each pair joins into listed fragments, a presentation reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts the joining.

Canonical source: [JoiningCodes.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JoiningCodes.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise for lifts_iff and tree_lifts. FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact takes excluded middle as a named hypothesis (not an axiom), each pair joining into listed fragments (FiniteOutcomes), and a presentation of the branching tests of the joining's frame (negation, conjunction and the left and right joining moves, no atomic claims) that is Exact and Reduced.

Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.
